name: ethskills
title_zh: Solidity 合约从审计到部署，一条龙问它就行
tagline_zh: 写合约、查漏洞、部署到 L2，ERC 标准、DeFi 协议全认识。不用自己翻文档，它直接给你可跑的代码和检查清单。
tagline_en: Write, audit, deploy Solidity across L2s. Knows ERC standards, DeFi protocols. Gives runnable code and.
desc_en: Use when a request involves Ethereum, the EVM, or blockchain systems. Applies to building, auditing, deploying, or interacting with smart contracts, dApps, wallets, or DeFi protocols. Covers Solidity development, contract addresses, token standards (ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-4626, etc.), Layer 2 networks (Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, zkSync, Polygon), and integrations with DeFi protocols such as Uniswap,
why_zh: 不是泛泛的区块链百科，而是带工程判断：能指出合约陷阱、给测试建议、按你的网络选对标准。
why_en: Not a blockchain encyclopedia—it brings engineering judgment: spots pitfalls, suggests tests, picks the right standard for your.
limit_zh: 只覆盖以太坊系（EVM）生态，不碰 Solana、Cosmos 等非 EVM 链。对合约安全只做静态审查。
limit_en: EVM-only; no Solana/Cosmos. Static review only—no dynamic analysis or formal verification. Outputs code & advice, not post-deploy monitoring.
title_en: Solidity contracts: audit, deploy, interact—ask it all
